column2: 中古英语 theorothycall ← 拉丁语 theoreticus ＋ -al ← 希腊语 theoretikos（善于观照的）← theoria（观照、思辨）
column3: based on ideas and reasoning rather than on practice
column5: The plan works in theoretical terms only.|She does theoretical physics at the university.
column6: worked out in reasoning, not yet tried in practice – 在推理上成立，尚未在实做中验过
column7: 理论上的：只在道理上讲得通|理论的：属于理论这一部分的，与实验相对

column2: 借自中古法语 théorie ← 晚期拉丁语 theoria ← 希腊语 theoria（观照、思辨）← theoros（观看者）
column3: a set of ideas put forward to explain how something works
column5: His theory explains both results.|In theory it should work.
column6: a reasoned account offered to explain what is seen – 为解释所见之事提出的一套讲法
column7: 理论：成体系的解释|学说：某人或某派提出的那一套主张|看法：日常里指个人的推测

column2: 借自新拉丁语 therapia ← 希腊语 therapeia（服侍、医治）← therapeuo（服侍、施治）
column3: treatment intended to relieve an illness or difficulty
column5: She has been in therapy for a year.|Physical therapy restored his movement.
column6: a course of treatment carried on over time – 持续一段时间的调治过程
column7: 治疗：为除病痛而进行的处置|疗法：具体采用的那一套治法

column2: 中古英语 therafter ← 古英语 þǣræfter（在那以后），即 there ＋ after
column3: after that time or event
column5: He moved to Leeds and lived there thereafter.|The rule applied to all cases thereafter.
column6: from that point onward in time – 从那一点起往后
column7: 此后：从刚说的那时起往后|其后：偏书面，指紧随其后的时段

column2: 中古英语 therby ← 古英语 þǣrbig（凭此），即 there ＋ by
column3: by that means, with that as the cause
column5: He signed the form, thereby accepting the terms.|Costs fell, thereby raising profit.
column6: by way of the thing just mentioned – 靠刚说的那件事，从而如此
column7: 由此：凭着前面那一步|因此：把前面那一步当作原因

column2: 源自法语 thermal ← 新拉丁语 *thermalis ← 希腊语 therme（热）← 原始印欧语 *gʷʰer-（使热）
column3: relating to heat, or made to keep heat in
column5: The house has thermal insulation.|Thermal images show where heat escapes.
column6: having to do with heat and how it moves – 与热及热的进出有关
column7: 热的：与温度或热量有关的|保温的：为把热留住而做的

column2: 中古英语 thikke ← 古英语 þicce（厚的、密的）← 原始日耳曼语 *þekuz（厚）← 原始印欧语 *tegus（厚）
column3: having a large distance between two opposite surfaces, or densely packed
column5: He cut a thick slice of bread.|Thick fog closed the airport.
column6: having much material between one side and the other – 两面之间的料多
column7: 厚的：两个表面隔得远|浓的：液体里所含的料多，流得慢|密的：单位地方里挤着的东西多

column2: 中古英语 thef ← 古英语 þēof ← 原始西日耳曼语 *þeub ← 原始日耳曼语 *þeubaz（贼）
column3: a person who steals
column5: A thief took her purse on the bus.|Police caught the thief that night.
column6: one who takes what belongs to others in secret – 暗中取走别人东西的那个人
column7: 小偷：日常说法，多指偷小物的人|窃贼：偏书面，语气更重

column2: 中古英语 thigh ← 古英语 þēoh ← 原始西日耳曼语 *þeuh ← 原始日耳曼语 *þeuhą ← 原始印欧语 *tewk-
column3: the part of the leg between the hip and the knee
column5: He pulled a muscle in his thigh.|The bandage went round her thigh.
column6: the upper part of the leg, between hip and knee – 腿的上半段，在髋与膝之间

column2: 中古英语 thinne ← 古英语 þynne ← 原始日耳曼语 *þunnuz（薄）← 原始印欧语 *tenh₂us（薄）← *ten-（拉伸）
column3: having only a small distance between two opposite surfaces
column5: Cut the ham into thin slices.|He looked thin after the illness.
column6: having little material between one side and the other – 两面之间的料少
column7: 薄的：两个表面隔得近|瘦的：人身上的肉少|稀的：液体里所含的料少，流得快

column2: 中古英语 thing ← 古英语 þing ← 原始西日耳曼语 *þing ← 原始日耳曼语 *þingą；本义是「集会」，后指会上所议之事，最终泛指一切事物
column3: any object, fact, or matter that one does not name exactly
column5: Put your things in the cupboard.|The strange thing is that nobody noticed.
column6: whatever one points at without naming it – 指得出来却不点名的那个
column7: 东西：具体的物件|事情：所发生或所议的那件事|事物：把物与事合起来说的通称

column2: 中古英语 thinken ← 古英语 þenċan（思、想）← 原始日耳曼语 *þankijaną（想）← 原始印欧语 *teng-（感知、想）
column3: to use the mind to consider something
column5: Let me think about it overnight.|I think she is right.
column6: turning something over in the mind – 把一件事在脑子里来回过
column7: 想：在脑中过念头|认为：想过之后持某个判断|思考：想得更久更深，带推理

column2: 中古英语 thirst ← 古英语 þurst ← 原始日耳曼语 *þurstuz ← 原始印欧语 *ters-（干）
column3: the feeling of needing to drink
column5: He drank deeply to quench his thirst.|She has a thirst for knowledge.
column6: the dryness that makes one need to drink – 干得非喝不可的那种感觉
column7: 渴：身体缺水时的感觉|口渴：同义，点明是口中发干|渴求：把这份急需用到别的事上

column2: 中古英语 thirsty ← 古英语 þurstiġ，即 thirst ＋ 形容词后缀 -y
column3: needing or wanting to drink
column5: I am thirsty after that walk.|Give the horses some water; they are thirsty.
column6: in the state of needing to drink – 处在非喝不可的状态里
column7: 渴的：身体缺水而想喝|口渴的：同义，点明口中发干

column2: 中古英语 thirttene ← 古英语 þrēotīene ← 原始日耳曼语 *þritehun，由 *þrīz（三）＋ *tehun（十）复合而成
column3: the number that comes after twelve
column5: She turns thirteen next month.|There were thirteen people at the table.
column6: the count reached by adding three to ten – 十再加三得出的那个数

column2: 中古英语 thorn ← 古英语 þorn ← 原始日耳曼语 *þurnaz ← 原始印欧语 *tr̥nós ← *(s)ter-（硬、挺）
column3: a sharp point growing on the stem of a plant
column5: A thorn pricked her finger.|The hedge is full of thorns.
column6: a hard sharp point growing out of a stem – 从茎上长出来的硬尖
column7: 刺：植物身上那根尖|棘刺：连着带刺灌木一起说，语气更硬

column2: 中古英语 thoruȝ ← 古英语 þuruh，是 þurh（穿过）的变体；形容词义由介词与副词转来
column3: done completely, leaving nothing out
column5: They made a thorough search of the flat.|She is thorough in everything she does.
column6: going right through, missing no part – 一路穿到底，没有落下的地方
column7: 彻底的：做到尽处，不留余地|周密的：各处都想到、都查到

column2: 中古英语 thought ← 古英语 þōht ← 原始日耳曼语 *þanhtaz ← 原始印欧语 *teng-（感知、想）；与 think、thank 同支
column3: an idea produced by thinking
column5: A sudden thought struck him.|She gave the matter much thought.
column6: what the mind turns out after working on something – 脑子过完一件事后得出的那个
column7: 想法：脑中成形的那个念头|思索：想这个过程本身|看法：想过之后所持的判断

column2: 中古英语 thoȝtful，即 thought ＋ 形容词后缀 -ful；thought 一支 ← 古英语 þōht（念、想）
column3: showing care for what others need, or deep in thought
column4: 体贴的/考虑周到的/沉思的
column5: It was thoughtful of you to call.|He sat thoughtful for a long while.
column6: having given the matter or the person real thought – 对事或对人真正想过一遍
column7: 体贴的：先想到别人的需要|考虑周到的：各方面都想过，安排得妥|沉思的：正陷在思索里的样子

column2: 中古英语 thred ← 古英语 þrǣd ← 原始日耳曼语 *þrēduz ← 原始印欧语 *terh₁-（搓、拧）
column3: a long thin strand of cotton or silk used in sewing
column5: She threaded the needle with black thread.|I lost the thread of his argument.
column6: a very thin strand spun long enough to sew with – 搓得细而长、够用来缝的一股
column7: 线：缝纫用的那种细股|丝线：以丝搓成的那种，更细更亮|脉络：话或文里那条贯穿始终的细股

column2: 中古英语 threte ← 古英语 þrēat（挤压、逼迫、威胁）← 原始日耳曼语 *þrautaz ← 原始印欧语 *trewd-（挤、压）
column3: a statement or sign that harm may come
column5: He made a threat against the witness.|Rising seas are a threat to the town.
column6: a sign that harm is being held over you – 有害之事悬在头上的那个信号
column7: 威胁：使人不得不顾忌的压力|恐吓：明说要加害的那种话|隐患：尚未发作但可能致害的因素

column2: 中古英语 thretenen ← 古英语 þrēatnian（逼迫、催促），即 threat ＋ 起始体后缀 -en
column3: to say or show that harm may come
column5: He threatened to call the police.|Dark clouds threatened the harvest.
column6: holding harm over something so it may yet fall – 把祸事悬在对方头上，随时可能落下
column7: 威胁：使对方顾忌而让步|恐吓：明白说出要加害|预示：自然现象显出将有祸事

column2: 中古英语 thre ← 古英语 þrī ← 原始日耳曼语 *þrīz ← 原始印欧语 *tréyes（三）
column3: the number that comes after two
column5: Three cups stood on the table.|The meeting lasted three hours.
column6: the count reached by adding one to two – 二再加一得出的那个数

column2: 中古英语 threschwolde ← 古英语 þresċold（门下横木）← 原始日耳曼语 *þreskudlaz ← *þreskaną（原义踩、后作打谷）← 原始印欧语 *terh₁-（搓、转）
column3: the strip of floor at the bottom of a doorway, or the point at which something starts
column5: He paused on the threshold.|Pain begins above this threshold.
column6: the line you must cross to be inside – 跨过去才算进来的那道线
column7: 门槛：门下那道横木|临界点：过了它性质就变的那个数值|起点：一件事刚开始的那一处

column2: 中古英语 thrift ← 古诺尔斯语 þrift（兴旺、富足），即 thrive ＋ 抽象名词后缀 -t
column3: careful use of money so that little is wasted
column5: Years of thrift paid for the house.|She was taught thrift as a child.
column6: spending sparingly so that what one has lasts – 花得省，好让手里的经得住用
column7: 节俭：用钱有节制|俭省：把开销压到低处

column2: 英语 thrill ← 古英语 þȳrlian（穿孔、刺穿）← þȳrel（孔）；「使激动」义由「像被刺穿一样一阵战栗」引申
column3: to make someone feel a sudden strong excitement
column5: The ride thrilled the children.|A thrill ran down his spine.
column6: a jolt of feeling that runs right through you – 一阵感觉像被扎透一样穿过身体
column7: 使激动：让人一阵兴奋|兴奋感：那阵感觉本身|震颤：本义即刺穿后的那阵抖

column2: 中古英语 thryven ← 古诺尔斯语 þrífa（抓住、兴旺）← 原始日耳曼语 *þrībaną ← 原始印欧语 *terp-（满足、享有）
column3: to grow strongly and do well
column4: 兴旺/茁壮成长/蓬勃发展
column5: The business thrived after the move.|These plants thrive in poor soil.
column6: growing well because conditions suit it – 条件对，于是长得旺
column7: 兴旺：事业或生意做得起来|茁壮成长：动植物长得结实|蓬勃发展：势头旺、扩展快

column2: 中古英语 trone ← 古法语 trone ← 拉丁语 thronus ← 希腊语 thronos（座椅）；取代了旧词 seld
column3: the ceremonial seat of a king or queen
column5: The queen sat on the throne.|He came to the throne at nineteen.
column6: the raised seat that marks who rules – 标明谁在位的那把高座
column7: 宝座：君主所坐的那把椅|王位：由那把椅代表的君主之位

column2: 中古英语 thrugh ← 古英语 þurh ← 原始日耳曼语 *þurhw（穿过）← 原始印欧语 *terh₂-（穿过）
column3: from one side or end of something to the other
column5: The train went through the tunnel.|She read through the whole file.
column6: entering at one side and coming out the other – 从一头进去，从另一头出来
column7: 穿过：从物体内部由此端到彼端|通过：借某条路或某种手段达成|自始至终：从头贯到尾，不中断

column2: 由 through ＋ out 构成 ← 古英语 þurh ūt（一路穿出）
column3: in every part of, or during the whole of
column5: The news spread throughout the country.|It rained throughout the night.
column6: reaching every part or every moment, with nothing left out – 每一处或每一刻都到，没有落下的
column7: 遍及：空间上每一处都到|贯穿：从这头到那头连成一条|始终：时间上从头到尾都如此
